title: ArchiMate
trademark: ArchiMate® is a registered trademark of The Open Group. Turbo EA draws the ArchiMate notation and is not certified by The Open Group.

relationshipDefinitions.Composition: A part that cannot exist without the whole.
relationshipDefinitions.Aggregation: A part that can exist independently of the whole.
relationshipDefinitions.Assignment: Assigns responsibility for behavior, or allocates resources.
relationshipDefinitions.Realization: A concrete element realizes a more abstract one.
relationshipDefinitions.Serving: One element provides functionality to another.
relationshipDefinitions.Access: A behavior element reads or writes a passive object.
relationshipDefinitions.Influence: One element positively or negatively influences another.
relationshipDefinitions.Triggering: One behavior triggers another in time.
relationshipDefinitions.Flow: Transfer of value or information between behaviors.
relationshipDefinitions.Specialization: An element is a more specific kind of another.
relationshipDefinitions.Association: A generic relationship not expressed by another type.
